_comment: Phase 13.4 — Lighthouse CI perf budgets per UI/UX brief surface types.
Stream:         Home, Pulse, Learn        (FCP ≤1.6s LCP ≤2.5s TTI ≤3.5s)
Workspace:      Work Studio, Solva sub-mods (FCP ≤1.8s LCP ≤2.8s TTI ≤4.0s)
Reading:        ReadingView, briefing detail (FCP ≤1.4s LCP ≤2.2s TTI ≤3.0s)
Structural:     Cycle Manager, Monitor      (FCP ≤1.8s LCP ≤2.8s TTI ≤4.0s)
Authenticated routes are NOT in this baseline; we scan the public
surface that exercises each bucket's shared chrome (Stream = /,
Conversational = /signin). Authenticated runs land in 13.x+1 with
`assertions` use the strictest budget across the buckets above so
the first run produces a baseline rather than an arbitrary fail.
All assertions are 'warn' on first run — the gate hardens later.
